action.title: Action
action.description: Operation to perform: fetch (Markdown/text extraction), screenshot (headless Chromium image), inspect (structured SEO & site intelligence), batch_fetch (parallel multi-URL retrieval), bulk_inspect (B2B Lead & Tech-Stack Enrichment across up to 50 domains), or map (discover internal URLs from sitemaps & links).

url.title: Target URL
url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS webpage or PDF URL (used for fetch, screenshot, inspect, and map).

urls.title: Batch / Bulk Target URLs or Domains
urls.description: List of public URLs or bare domains (e.g. stripe.com) for batch_fetch (up to 5 URLs) or bulk_inspect (up to 50 domains for paying users, 5 on the Free plan).

search.title: Map URL Search Filter
search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter when action is 'map' (e.g. 'docs' or 'pricing').

include_subdomains.title: Include Subdomains (Map)
include_subdomains.description: Include URLs on subdomains of the target domain when action is 'map'.

max_urls.title: Maximum Mapped URLs
max_urls.description: Maximum number of URLs to return when action is 'map' (1-500).

query.title: Lead Search Query
query.description: Business or niche search query when action is 'search_leads' (e.g. 'dental clinics austin tx').

lead_source.title: Lead Source
lead_source.description: Lead discovery source when action is 'search_leads': 'maps' (Google Places) or 'web'.

max_leads.title: Maximum Enriched Leads
max_leads.description: Maximum number of leads to enrich when action is 'search_leads' (up to 25 paying, 5 free).

max_chars.title: Maximum Characters
max_chars.description: Maximum character length returned for extracted Markdown and plain text.

render_mode.title: Render Mode
render_mode.description: Rendering strategy: 'auto' (fast HTTP with automatic headless Chromium escalation on SPA shells), 'http_only', or 'browser'.

full_page.title: Full Page Screenshot
full_page.description: Capture the full scrollable page height (up to 4000px).

image_format.title: Screenshot Image Format
image_format.description: Output image format for screenshots ('jpeg' or 'png').
